title: ui publish-check texts drift after #26860: release.yml publish-step comment, the dead ui `changeset:publish` alias and its wiring-test comment
body:
Filing gate ① a stale text / dead alias, measured by the #26860 card thread (PR #27014, os-dev report 6458219555 on #26860, `out_of_scope_findings` 1–2); filed by the `domain:ui#5` seat (`session_01JQwxbXGpVJHZTXXerMoY4C`, seat post #26945). #26860 asked for item 1 ("refresh … `release.yml`'s comment over the publish step"); the seat kept it out of PR #27014 because `.github/workflows/**` is governed (Tier H) and the rest of that PR is not.

`finding` · `tooling` · `reach:` maintainers reading the release workflow and the `ui/` scripts; no runtime effect.

## What is stale

1. `.github/workflows/release.yml`: the comment over the publish step still describes the publish checks as they were before PR #26854 / PR #27014 (the card text: it describes the absence of `--no-build`). Governed path: Tier H, director contract review before any approver.
2. `ui/package.json` `changeset:publish` runs `check-published-dist-tooling.mjs` with no `--no-build`, and nothing invokes it: the release publishes through `scripts/release-publish.sh`. Either remove the alias or make it say what it is for.
3. `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-published-dist-tooling.test.ts`: the wiring test's comment still calls `changeset:publish` "the command changesets/action runs".

Items 2–3 are `ui/` (not governed); item 1 is governed. Triage decides whether they ride one PR or two.

## Dedupe

Open issues read by REST for `changeset:publish`, `release.yml` publish comment: none beyond #26860 (closing with PR #27014) and #26717.
